resistance_ohm.rationale: About 440 ohm measured K7222.25 replacement; 649–1298 ohm original-winding copper geometry estimate. Rounded cross-revision exploration envelope, not a .11 resistance measurement.

leakage_h.rationale: Unmeasured engineering hypothesis; not original UHA78 winding data.

capacitance_f.rationale: Independent CRT LOPT study reports overwind self-capacitance around 7–8 pF; 5–20 pF admits transfer uncertainty and prior 15 pF hypothesis, not a .11 measurement.

source_basis.limit: The 1768-turn/440-ohm winding is a K7222.25 repair; 0.92 coupling and 7–8 pF capacitance come from a different CRT LOPT. The original K7222.11 values are not measured.

high_voltage_coupling.rationale: Independent CRT LOPT study reports typical primary-to-overwind k 0.5–0.97 and measured example k=0.92. ÜHA78 replacement author reports EHT varies with overwind axial position; no .11 k measurement.
